thread:
sam_partners: Idea: build a 'Module Factory' partner onboarding kit. One repo that scaffolds opinionated Terraform modules, CI, signing, and marketplace metadata. Partners fork, fill values, run CI, open PR. Small live lab.

ida_eng: love the idea. makes partner ramp repeatable. key things to cover: module versioning, changelog, and a smoke test that runs a tiny inference call at the end.

jules_infra: i'll own the CI templates. pattern: PR -> fmt -> terrascan -> init/plan -> optional smoke (gated). we'll provide a local runner guide for partners who can't run cloud CI.

mina_docs: i'll write the scaffold README + a short CONTRIBUTING.md that explains semver for modules and release tagging (v1.0.0 etc.). also include marketplace.json metadata example so the portal can auto-read display name, publisher, and contact.

ev an_partner: (evan_partner) our team wants the smoke test to avoid sending customer data. can the example use a synthetic input and redact keys? also show how to replace with partner endpoint.

ida_eng: yes — sample smoke script will use a synthetic payload and read REDWOOD_API_KEY from env. we will add a note: never commit real keys. provide a small helper script: `scripts/smoke.sh` that exits non-zero on failure.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: marketplace requires either signed artifact OR manual review. Signed gets trust badge.

jules_infra: we'll add cosign example in CI and an optional KMS-backed signing path. snippet for demo slide:
```yaml
- name: Sign bundle
  run: |
    tar -czf module.tgz modules/sample
    cosign sign-blob --key ${{ secrets.COSIGN_KEY }} module.tgz > module.tgz.sig
```

mina_docs: good. i'll add a short troubleshooting table: common Terrascan rules, provider version mismatch, missing variables. also a section: "how to vendor modules into private registries".

sam_partners: timeline: ship scaffold repo and a 30min partner lab next Wed. deliverables: repo skeleton, CI templates, sample module, README, smoke script. RSVP by Fri.

ejan? (typo) evan_partner: we'll RSVP. can you add a checkbox list in README for partner legal/compliance steps (contact, signing policy acceptance)? helps our procurement.

mina_docs: yes — a short checklist: contact, security questionnaire link, whether they'll sign artifacts.

ida_eng: final ask: include a small metrics snippet in the repo that partners can optionally enable to track CI pass rate + marketplace validation status (prometheus/curl to our API). helps ops. keep it opt-in.

sam_partners: perfect. i'll create the repo under redwood-partners/module-factory and open the initial PR with the skeleton by Mon EOD. we'll reconvene Tue to review slides. :rocket:
